chunks: And when the wicked shall face the torment it will not be decreased, nor will they be reprieved.

key_terms.الظَّلَمُونَ: The wrongdoers / those who committed injustice
key_terms.يُنْظَرُونَ: They will be reprieved / granted respite

ai.seo_question: What happens to the wrongdoers' punishment on the Day of Judgment according to Surah An-Nahl?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the finality of divine justice, where the 'lightening' of punishment refers to the removal of mercy and the 'respite' denotes the cessation of the period of reckoning. It serves as a stark contrast to the patience granted in this world, emphasizing that for the persistent wrongdoers, the opportunity for repentance or mitigation has permanently closed.
